title: ZenChad Acceptance Meditation — 30-Second Four-Way Audition
spokenText:
Take a moment to settle... and let your body be held by whatever is beneath you.

There is nothing you need to fix right now.

Notice what is already here — perhaps a feeling... a thought... or a sensation. See if you can make just a little room for it.

You do not have to like it. For this moment... simply let it be here.
